en.headline: 91-year-old man dies after suspected choking at Ap Lei Chau care home
en.dek: Staff at a home on Lee Chi Road reported that a resident surnamed Kwok lost consciousness while eating wonton vermicelli on Sunday afternoon; he was taken to Queen Mary Hospital but later died.
body: A 91-year-old man died after he was suspected of choking while eating at a care home in Ap Lei Chau on Sunday afternoon.

Police received a report at about 5:43 p.m. from staff at Ap Lei Chau Home for the Elderly on 138 Lee Chi Road. The resident, surnamed Kwok, was believed to have choked while eating wonton vermicelli and had fallen unconscious.

He was transported by ambulance to Queen Mary Hospital for resuscitation but was later declared dead. Police have classified the case as a suspected choking incident. The exact cause of death will be determined by a post-mortem examination.
The man was a resident of the care home. No other details about the circumstances were immediately available.

zh.headline: 鴨脳洲院舍91歲翁疑食雲吞米線鯁喉 送院搶救後不治
zh.dek: 周日下午約5時43分利枝道院舍職員報案，指姓郭院友進食時疑鯁喉昏迷，送往瑪麗醫院後宣告不治，死因待驗屍確定。
body: 鴨脳洲一間護老院舍周日下午有91歲男院友懷疑進食時鯁喉，送院搶救後不治。
警方於下午約5時43分接獲利枝道138號鴨脳洲護老中心職員報案，指一名姓郭院友在進食雲吞米線期間懷疑鯁喉，不省人事。
救護人員將他送往瑪麗醫院搶救，其後宣告不治。警方將案件列作懷疑鯁喉意外處理，確實死因有待驗屍後確定。
事主為該院舍院友。事件其他詳情暫時未有進一步公布。
